title: OneDrive: sync up to 1 million items on macOS
summary: The controls, licensing and roadmap details are supported. The briefing should also say that Microsoft Support describes the million-item public preview as available, alongside the roadmap's development status and targets.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to raise the macOS OneDrive sync limit to 1 million items.
claims.quote: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices
claims.fix: After the roadmap status and dates in What's changing, add: 'Microsoft Support describes support for syncing up to 1,000,000 items as available in public preview for Windows and macOS.' The supporting source is already cited: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/restrictions-and-limitations-in-onedrive-and-sharepoint-64883a5d-228e-48f5-b3d2-eb39e07630fa. Keep the roadmap status and target dates.

claims.claim: The notice says the Mac increase follows the Windows increase announced in MC1294528.
claims.quote: In MC1294528, we announced an increase to the item sync limit for OneDrive on Windows. We are now increasing the same item sync limit for OneDrive on macOS

claims.claim: Microsoft intends the increase to help large OneDrive and SharePoint libraries sync reliably across devices.
claims.quote: This increase is designed to help organizations with large OneDrive and SharePoint libraries sync more content reliably across devices.

claims.claim: The capability is scheduled for Public Preview first and General Availability later.
claims.quote: The capability will be available first in Public Preview for devices enrolled in the Insiders ring, and later in General Availability.

claims.claim: The notice says performance is not yet optimised for accounts under legal hold.
claims.quote: Performance is not yet optimized for syncing a high volume of read-only files or for accounts under legal hold.

claims.claim: Microsoft says it is working to improve those performance scenarios.
claims.quote: We are actively working to improve performance and reliability for these scenarios.

claims.claim: SharePoint limits recommends syncing no more than 300,000 files in a single OneDrive or team site library.
claims.quote: For optimum performance, we recommend syncing no more than 300,000 files in a single OneDrive or team site library.

claims.claim: The same performance issues can occur at 300,000 items or more across all synced libraries.
claims.quote: the same performance issues can occur if you have 300,000 items or more across all libraries you're syncing, even if you aren't syncing all items in those libraries.

claims.claim: The 300,000-item sync performance recommendation also applies to shortcut folders.
claims.quote: The 300K file “soft” limit for OneDrive Sync also applies to shortcut folders.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Tier sets the update ring rather than a numerical item limit.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive macOS 1 million items sync limit enable disable setting default; OneDrive million sync enable macOS. Read Mac settings including Tier, Support preview prerequisites and update process; no separate limit switch. Tier is described as choosing an update ring.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: The Intune preference-file deployment documentation names the Policy and Profile Manager built-in role.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Intune admin center with an account that has the Policy and Profile Manager built-in role.

claims.claim: The Mac Tier section lists Insiders, Production and Enterprise, also known as Deferred.
claims.quote: The OneDrive sync app updates to the public through three rings; first to Insiders, then to Production, and finally to Deferred. Enterprise (also known as "Deferred")

claims.claim: The Mac page's Tier section does not describe Intune deployment.
claims.quote: Searched: Tier section of Deploy and configure the OneDrive sync app for Mac for Intune; read the complete section. It gives the rings, plist location, domain and key, but no Intune deployment steps. Other sections of the page do mention Intune.

claims.where: controls[1]; Governance controls table and prose; Open questions
claims.claim: No admin UI or API setting specifically turning the million-item sync limit on or off is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive macOS 1 million items sync limit enable disable setting default Insiders; OneDrive million sync enable macOS. Read Mac settings, Tier, Support preview prerequisites and update process; found ring selection, not a dedicated item-limit UI or API.

claims.claim: Users cannot change the update ring after an administrator enables Tier and selects a ring.
claims.quote: When you enable this setting and select a ring, users aren't able to change it.

claims.claim: Intune does not validate settings in a property list file.
claims.quote: Test your changes before assigning the profile to your devices. Intune doesn't validate the settings in the property list file.

claims.claim: Intune preference-file deployment requires macOS devices to be enrolled and MDM managed by Intune.
claims.quote: The device must be enrolled and MDM managed by Intune.

claims.claim: Production is the default sync app update ring.
claims.quote: Production: The Production ring users get the latest features as they become available. This ring is the default.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends leaving users other than the selected early adopters on the default Production ring.
claims.quote: We also recommend leaving everyone else in the organization in the default Production ring to ensure they receive bug fixes and new features in a timely fashion.

claims.claim: Update-ring selection is the only documented configurable control for access to this preview.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive macOS 1 million items sync limit enable disable setting default; OneDrive million sync enable macOS. Read Support preview prerequisites, Mac settings and update process; hardware and configuration prerequisites are named, but no other preview-access switch.

claims.claim: Preview and General Availability rollout timing for GCC, GCC High and DoD is not stated separately.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive million sync GCC App Store. Read roadmap and MC1477187 and searched Support preview text for government-cloud schedules; the record has general targets, the notice schedules only Worldwide, and no separate government schedule was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated when read-only-file and legal-hold performance will improve or whether GA will wait for it.
claims.quote: Searched: OneDrive sync million items legal hold read-only performance improvement General Availability. Read MC1477187 and Support preview notes and searched returned release-note excerpts; the sources promise work on these scenarios but give no completion date or GA dependency.
